transforms.code:
# UX PRE-FLIGHT ONLY -- see Global Constraint 6. Every check below is
	# re-run by Workorder.DieCastShiftReconciliation_Save, which refuses
	# authoritatively. This list exists so Save can say WHY it is disabled
	# rather than failing on click.
	U  = BlueRidge.Common.Util
	st = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state) or {}
	hd = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.header) or {}
	act = st.get("actual") or {}
	lots = st.get("lotLines") or []
	rejs = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	moves = st.get("moves") or []
	out = []

	if st.get("reasonId") is None:
		out.append("Choose a reason for this reconciliation.")
	elif BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.reasonRequiresNote(
			st.get("reasonId")) and not (st.get("note") or "").strip():
		# Save line 498 refuses this. Without the mirror the operator gets a
		# clean-looking sheet, an enabled button, and a refusal on click.
		out.append("This reason needs a note saying what happened.")

	hasLines = len(lots) > 0 or len(rejs) > 0
	total = act.get("totalShots")
	good  = act.get("goodShots")
	warm  = act.get("warmUpShots")

	# Save line 904: refused when moves, the LOT plan and scrap are all empty
	# and the actual total is unset. A sheet with a reason picked and nothing
	# else touched -- no LOT line, no reject line, no move, no actual figure
	# -- satisfies every clause of that refusal, and nothing else below
	# checks for it since there is no line to gate on.
	if (not hasLines and not moves
	        and total is None and good is None and warm is None):
		out.append("Nothing to save: the record already matches actual.")

	# ---- reject lines (Save sec 8) -- independent of the actual totals; a
	# bad reject line is refused whether or not the totals are filled in. ----
	if rejs:
		activeCodeIds = set()
		warmCodeId = None
		for dc in (BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getAll() or []):
			activeCodeIds.add(dc.get("Id"))
			if (dc.get("Code") or "") == "999":
				warmCodeId = dc.get("Id")

		badWarm = False
		for r in rejs:
			if r.get("defectCodeId") == warmCodeId:
				badWarm = True
		if badWarm:
			# Save line 705. The reject dropdown can't filter this out on its
			# own -- DefectCode_List / getForDropdown don't carry
			# IsNonRejectScrap -- so this is the only gate in front of it.
			out.append("Warm-up is entered as warm-up shots, not as a reject line.")

		badLine = False
		for r in rejs:
			qty = r.get("quantity")
			if qty is None or qty < 0 or r.get("defectCodeId") not in activeCodeIds:
				badLine = True
		if badLine:
			# Save line 708.
			out.append("A reject line has an unknown reason or a missing amount.")

		# Save lines 730-738: the span check only runs once every line above
		# has passed -- one bad line refuses the whole batch before the span
		# math is ever reached, so mirror that instead of dividing by garbage.
		if not badWarm and not badLine:
			cavRows = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.cavities) or []
			spanZero = False
			badSpan = None
			for r in rejs:
				itemId = r.get("itemId")
				if itemId is None:
					span = len(cavRows)
				else:
					span = 0
					for c in cavRows:
						if c.get("ItemId") == itemId:
							span += 1
				if span == 0:
					spanZero = True
				elif badSpan is None and (r.get("quantity") or 0) % span != 0:
					badSpan = (r.get("quantity") or 0, span)
			if spanZero:
				out.append("A reject line names a part that no cavity on this die was making during this shift.")
			elif badSpan is not None:
				out.append("%s does not divide evenly across %s cavities. Enter it against each part instead."
				           % (badSpan[0], badSpan[1]))

	# A11: LOT or reject lines require the three actual totals; a save with
	# only moves does not -- the checks below cannot run without them.
	# Save line 780 also refuses a NEGATIVE actual figure alongside a missing
	# one -- the numeric inputs carry a min of 0 too, but that only stops new
	# typing, not an already-staged negative.
	if hasLines and (total is None or good is None or warm is None
	                 or total < 0 or good < 0 or warm < 0):
		out.append("Enter the actual total shots, good shots and warm-up shots.")
		return out

	if total is not None and good is not None and warm is not None:
		# EQUALITY, not ">". Save line 782 is `IF @Total <> @Good + @Warm` and
		# refuses either way. A ">"-only mirror leaves total=900 good=750
		# warm=12 with an empty blocker strip and an enabled Save that then
		# fails on click, against a rule the operator was never shown.
		if good + warm != total:
			out.append("Total shots %s should equal good shots %s + warm-up %s = %s. One of them has a typo."
			           % ("{:,}".format(total), "{:,}".format(good),
			              "{:,}".format(warm), "{:,}".format(good + warm)))
		cav    = hd.get("ActiveCavities") or 0
		if cav == 0:
			# Save line 701. Without this the zero silently makes expected
			# negative and surfaces as a baffling LOT-sum message instead.
			out.append("This die had no active cavities during this shift, so there is nothing to reconcile against.")
			return out
		noGood = sum([(r.get("quantity") or 0) for r in rejs])
		expected = good * cav - noGood
		lotSum   = sum([(l.get("quantity") or 0) for l in lots])
		if lots and lotSum != expected:
			out.append("LOT list totals %s; actual total good is %s. One of them has a typo."
			           % ("{:,}".format(lotSum), "{:,}".format(expected)))
		for l in lots:
			if (l.get("quantity") or 0) > good:
				out.append("%s is %s pieces, more than the shift's %s good shots."
				           % (l.get("ltt"), "{:,}".format(l.get("quantity") or 0),
				              "{:,}".format(good)))
	return out

customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
shiftId = self.view.params.shiftId
	cellId  = self.view.params.cellLocationId
	toolId  = self.view.params.toolId
	if shiftId is None or cellId is None or toolId is None:
		return
	R = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation
	header   = R.getHeaderOrEmpty(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	# IsStaged / StagedToShiftLabel are display-only fields this screen adds on
	# top of the SQL row -- entries is the flex-repeater's own bound source, so
	# stageMove()/undoMove() rewrite it in place to make the cards re-render
	# (a direct property write retriggers the binding; refreshBinding() from a
	# handler does not).
	# EnteredAtDisplay is pre-formatted to a STRING here, once, while EnteredAtEt
	# is still a real Date fresh off Common.Db -- stageMove()/undoMove() detach
	# entries through a JSON round trip, which does not preserve a Date's type,
	# so a card reading dateFormat() on the post-stage value renders "null".
	entries = []
	for r in (R.listEntries(shiftId, cellId, toolId) or []):
		d = dict(r, IsStaged=False, StagedToShiftLabel='')
		d["EnteredAtDisplay"] = (system.date.format(d["EnteredAtEt"], "MM/dd HH:mm")
		                         if d.get("EnteredAtEt") else "")
		entries.append(d)
	lots     = R.listLots(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	rejects  = R.listRejects(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	cavities = R.listCavities(shiftId, toolId)
	self.view.custom.header        = header
	self.view.custom.entries       = entries
	self.view.custom.lots          = lots
	self.view.custom.rejects       = rejects
	self.view.custom.cavities      = cavities
	self.view.custom.reasonOptions = R.reasonOptions()
	# Reject block's Approved-by dropdown -- ALL ACTIVE Location.AppUser rows
	# (every person has one from first PIN sign-in, so a QAS signer always
	# resolves), plus a leading Unapproved/blank choice: an unapproved reject
	# line is legitimate and becomes its own NULL-approver row (spec sec 6.2).
	# Pure projection onto the existing Users-screen helper -- no new named
	# query, no business logic.
	approverOptions = [{"label": "Unapproved", "value": None}]
	for u in (BlueRidge.Location.AppUser.getUserList() or []):
		name = u.get("DisplayName") or u.get("Initials") or ("User %s" % u.get("Id"))
		initials = u.get("Initials") or ""
		label = ("%s (%s)" % (name, initials)) if initials else name
		approverOptions.append({"label": label, "value": u.get("Id")})
	self.view.custom.approverOptions = approverOptions
	# Reject line rows reseed their local edit-copy from params whenever this
	# changes (mirrors DieCastEntry/DieWideLineRow's seedToken) -- a fresh load
	# is always a full structural reset.
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = 0
	# A shift with NOTHING on record is the Machine 202 case this screen exists
	# for. Say so explicitly -- an empty screen must never be mistaken for a
	# failed load.
	self.view.custom.isEmptyShift = (len(entries) == 0 and len(lots) == 0
	                                 and len(rejects) == 0)
	# Who the banner's "Reconciling as" line names -- not in the brief's custom
	# block; Step 4 needs a name + initials and header carries neither. Resolved
	# the same way every mutation on this screen will attribute itself, so the
	# banner can never name someone other than who Save credits.
	# The banner names WHO THIS SAVE WILL BE ATTRIBUTED TO, and that is
	# exactly session.custom.user: set by the PIN sign-in, and REPLACED by
	# the supervisor for the length of an elevation window. Already the right
	# answer, with no lookup.
	#
	# NOT Common.Session.currentAppUserId(): that is the MUTATION-attribution
	# resolver and it fires an ERROR TOAST ("Not saved / No one is signed in")
	# whenever nobody is attributed -- a scary toast on every load of a
	# read-only banner, on every load where no AD IdP exists, and in prod any
	# time an elevation lapses before the sheet mounts. It also cost an
	# AppUser.getUser round trip per load, and load() runs once per param.
	#
	# Reading scalars off the session wrapper is safe; it is read-modify-write
	# of a whole property object that silently loses writes.
	# GUARDED, and the guard is the point. This is a COSMETIC banner lookup
	# sitting upstream of the single load-bearing state write below. A session
	# property read returns a live property-tree wrapper, not a dict; it
	# normally supports .get(), but this project has at least one documented
	# case of a map-like value where .get() raises and only bracket access
	# works. If that happened here, load() would die BEFORE seeding state and
	# loadedStamp -- so the sheet would have no stale guard and no draft, from
	# a failure to render somebody's name. Bracket access with a catch-all
	# mirrors the on-point precedent in Common/Session (resetTerminal), and a
	# blank name is a cost worth paying to keep the load alive.
	name = ""
	initials = ""
	try:
		u = self.session.custom.user
		if u:
			name = u["displayName"] or ""
			initials = u["initials"] or ""
	except:
		BlueRidge.Common.Util.log("banner: could not read session.custom.user",
		                          level="warn")
	self.view.custom.currentUser = {"name": name, "initials": initials}
	# ONE property write. Seeding state in two steps lets a dirty binding
	# observe a half-loaded sheet and latch. The LOT lines start at their
	# RECORDED value so an untouched LOT contributes its existing number and
	# the totals reconcile before anything is typed.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"actual": {"totalShots": None, "goodShots": None, "warmUpShots": None},
		"reasonId": None,
		"note": "",
		"moves": [],
		"lotLines": [{"lotId": r.get("LotId"), "ltt": r.get("Ltt"),
		              "toolCavityId": r.get("ToolCavityId"),
		              "quantity": r.get("Recorded"), "isNew": False}
		             for r in lots],
		"rejectLines": [{"defectCodeId": r.get("DefectCodeId"), "itemId": r.get("ItemId"),
		                 "quantity": r.get("Quantity"),
		                 "approvedByUserId": r.get("ApprovedByUserId")}
		                for r in rejects],
		"loadedStamp": header.get("Stamp") or "",
	}

customMethods.name: stageMove
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	entryKey  = p.get("entryKey")
	toShiftId = p.get("toShiftId")
	entry = None
	for e in (self.view.custom.entries or []):
		if e.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			entry = e
			break
	if entry is None or toShiftId is None:
		return

	def ids(csv):
		return [int(x) for x in (csv or "").split(",") if x.strip()]

	# The Save takes one element PER ROW, not per entry. The grouping into
	# entries is presentation; ContributionIds / RejectIds are the real targets,
	# which is what stops a wrong grouping ever producing a wrong write.
	staged = [m for m in (self.view.custom.state.moves or [])
	          if m.get("entryKey") != entryKey]
	for cid in ids(entry.get("ContributionIds")):
		staged.append({"entryKey": entryKey, "entityType": "Contribution",
		               "entityId": cid, "toShiftId": toShiftId})
	for rid in ids(entry.get("RejectIds")):
		staged.append({"entryKey": entryKey, "entityType": "Reject",
		               "entityId": rid, "toShiftId": toShiftId})

	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	st["moves"] = staged
	self.view.custom.state = st

	# Card display join. entries is the flex-repeater's own bound source, so
	# rewriting it (not refreshBinding, which no-ops from a handler) is what
	# makes the cards re-render with their staged state.
	toShiftLabel = p.get("toShiftLabel") or ""
	ej = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.entries or [])
	entries = system.util.jsonDecode(ej)
	for row in entries:
		if row.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			row["IsStaged"] = True
			row["StagedToShiftLabel"] = toShiftLabel
	self.view.custom.entries = entries

customMethods.name: undoMove
customMethods.script:
if not entryKey:
		return

	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	st["moves"] = [m for m in (st.get("moves") or []) if m.get("entryKey") != entryKey]
	self.view.custom.state = st

	ej = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.entries or [])
	entries = system.util.jsonDecode(ej)
	for row in entries:
		if row.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			row["IsStaged"] = False
			row["StagedToShiftLabel"] = ""
	self.view.custom.entries = entries

customMethods.name: addRejectLine
customMethods.script:
# A fresh typed line, unapproved and unpicked -- the team lead fills it in.
	# The reject block's grain is (DefectCode, Part, Approver): a blank line
	# does not collide with anything because it carries no defect code yet.
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	lines.append({"defectCodeId": None, "itemId": None, "quantity": None, "approvedByUserId": None})
	st["rejectLines"] = lines
	self.view.custom.state = st
	# Bumps every row's seedToken so RejectLineRow re-syncs from params -- the
	# new blank row needs this to pick up its index; existing rows re-adopt
	# their own already-correct values, a no-op for them.
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: changeRejectLine
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	idx = p.get("index")
	if idx is None:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	if 0 <= idx < len(lines):
		lines[idx] = {"defectCodeId": p.get("defectCodeId"), "itemId": p.get("itemId"),
		              "quantity": p.get("quantity"), "approvedByUserId": p.get("approvedByUserId")}
		st["rejectLines"] = lines
		self.view.custom.state = st
	# rejectLinesSeed is DELIBERATELY NOT bumped here -- a field edit must not
	# force every other row to re-sync from params (it would clobber whatever
	# a team lead is mid-typing in a different row). Seed is a STRUCTURAL
	# reset signal only (add/remove), matching DieCastEntry/DieWideLineRow.

customMethods.name: removeRejectLine
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	idx = p.get("index")
	if idx is None:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	if 0 <= idx < len(lines):
		del lines[idx]
	st["rejectLines"] = lines
	self.view.custom.state = st
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0) + 1

transforms.code:
shiftId = self.view.params.shiftId
	cellId = self.view.params.cellLocationId
	toolId = self.view.params.toolId
	fromLabel = self.view.custom.header.ShiftLabel
	out = []
	for r in (value or []):
		row = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(r) or {}
		out.append({
			"entry": row,
			"shiftId": shiftId,
			"cellLocationId": cellId,
			"toolId": toolId,
			"fromShiftLabel": fromLabel,
			"isStaged": row.get("IsStaged") or False,
			"stagedToShiftLabel": row.get("StagedToShiftLabel") or "",
		})
	return out

st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(value) or {}
	rejs = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	total = sum([(r.get("quantity") or 0) for r in rejs])
	rec = self.view.custom.header.RecordedNoGood or 0
	diff = total - rec
	sign = "+" if diff > 0 else ""
	return "%s%s" % (sign, "{:,}".format(diff))

props.text: No-good and Total good are worked out from the reject block and good shots x cavities.

transforms.code:
rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(value) or []
	if not rows:
		return ""
	# One line PER ROW, never flattened -- two approvers on one code stay two
	# lines, each owning only its own quantity (grain: DefectCode, Part, Approver).
	lines = []
	for r in rows:
		part = r.get("PartNumber") or "All"
		appr = r.get("ApprovedBy") or "Unapproved"
		lines.append((r.get("DefectCode") or "?") + " - " + part + " - " + "{:,}".format(r.get("Quantity") or 0) + " pcs - " + appr)
	return "\n".join(lines)

_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	rows = _u(value) or []
	defectOpts = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getForDropdown("DieCast") or []
	# Part dropdown: All (itemId null) plus the die's distinct parts, off the
	# same cavity set the LTT bar and the Save both resolve from.
	cavRows = _u(self.view.custom.cavities) or []
	seen = set()
	partOpts = [{"label": "All", "value": None}]
	for c in cavRows:
		iid = c.get("ItemId")
		if iid is None or iid in seen:
			continue
		seen.add(iid)
		partOpts.append({"label": c.get("PartNumber") or ("Item %s" % iid), "value": iid})
	apprOpts = _u(self.view.custom.approverOptions) or []
	seed = self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0
	out = []
	for i, r in enumerate(rows):
		r = r or {}
		out.append({
			"index": i,
			"defectCodeId": r.get("defectCodeId"),
			"itemId": r.get("itemId"),
			"quantity": r.get("quantity"),
			"approvedByUserId": r.get("approvedByUserId"),
			"defectOptions": defectOpts,
			"partOptions": partOpts,
			"approverOptions": apprOpts,
			"seedToken": seed,
		})
	return out

props.text: "All" spreads the amount across every cavity. Approved by is the QAS who signed off -- it may be left Unapproved.
